note: Tools for making games, not playing them. Every card opens that tool's own page; Game Center installs nothing and runs none of it.
notice: Community-made, not affiliated with Nous Research or with Game Center.

items.title: Game Dev
items.summary: Read-only look at a Godot project: files, assets, a playable-slice checklist.

items.title: GameForge
items.summary: Sound, music, sprites, 3D models, four web genres, Godot and Unity builds, a playtester.

items.title: Godot Studio
items.summary: Headless Godot 4 checks and exports, with a builds gallery.
items.note: Needs Godot 4. No licence file in its repository.

items.title: Game Editor
items.summary: Places assets in the Godot scene open in your editor, plays it, fixes what broke.
items.note: macOS only. Needs Godot 4.7 and the Godot AI add-on.

items.title: C# Game Editor
items.summary: Builds a Unity script, object and scene from one feature description.
items.note: macOS only. Needs Unity and MCP for Unity.

items.title: Pixel Art
items.summary: Turns a picture into era-correct pixel art, then into a short animated loop.
